mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LLM_EXTRACT_RUN ( PROCESS_TYPE, TRANSFER_YEAR, PROD_YEAR, RETRY_FAIL, BATCH_SIZE, MAX_LOOP, STATUS, STARTED_AT ) VALUES ( #{processType}, #{transferYear}, #{prodYear}, #{retryFail}, #{batchSize}, #{maxLoop}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) )
mapper.update: UPDATE LLM_EXTRACT_RUN SET STATUS = #{status}, ENDED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), LOOP_COUNT = #{loopCount}, TOTAL_TARGET_COUNT = #{totalTargetCount}, TOTAL_SUCCESS_COUNT = #{totalSuccessCount}, TOTAL_FAIL_COUNT = #{totalFailCount}, ERROR_MSG = #{errorMsg}, UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId}

UPDATE LLM_EXTRACT_RUN SET LOOP_COUNT = #{loopCount}, TOTAL_TARGET_COUNT = #{totalTargetCount}, TOTAL_SUCCESS_COUNT = #{totalSuccessCount}, TOTAL_FAIL_COUNT = #{totalFailCount}, UPDATE_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId} AND STATUS = 'RUNNING'
